info.title: CSV-to-Parquet Stream Compressor
info.description: Converts delimited-text uploadscsv/.tsv/.txt multipart uploads into ZSTD-compressed Apache Parquet via PyArrow on RunPod serverless CPU. Settled with x402 v2 USDC on Base.

get.summary: Service health probe (free, no payment required)

200.description: Plain-text crawler manifest describing the service and its endpoints
JSON discovery manifest describing the service, capabilities, pricing tiers, x402 payment parameters, and endpoints
JSON MCP tools descriptor for integrating this service with Model Context Protocol clients

post.summary: Convert a CSV/TSV/TXT file to ZSTD-compressed Parquet
post.description: First unauthenticated call returns 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header manifest containing the exact micro-USDC amount for the request. Pay in USDC on Base per that manifest, then retry the identical request adding a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header with the payment proof. Pricing tiers (upper bounds inclusive — a file of exactly an upper bound prices in that tier): under 104857600 bytes flat $0.01; up to 10737418240 bytes $0.10/GB; up to 107374182400 bytes $0.05/GB (BYO storage required >=10GB); up to 1099511627776 bytes $0.015/GB (BYO); above 1099511627776 bytes $0.008/GB (BYO). Minimum charge $0.01. The 402 manifest carries the exact micro-USDC amount.

target_destination.description: Optional JSON string describing an S3-compatible destination. Required when input >= 10 GiB (10737418240 bytes).

200.description: Compression succeeded; result stored at presigned R2 link or caller-supplied destination

drift_fallback.description: true when a mid-file type drift triggered the lossless all-string re-read

download_url.description: presigned link; internal destination only (24h retention)

400.description: Bad request — missing/invalid multipart fields, unsupported input format, or missing target_destination for a >= 10 GB output

402.description: Payment required. The response carries a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header whose value is a base64url-encoded JSON manifest shaped exactly like the live challenge: {"x402Version":2,"error":"Payment required","resource":{"url":"https://csv-parquet.YOURDOMAIN.workers.dev/v1/compress","description":"CSV/TSV/TXT to Parquet conversion"},"accepts":[{"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","amount":"<exact micro-USDC for this request>","asset":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","payTo":"0x795dCA28d0e8a0E5d19D689163f125a7da1D0B83","maxTimeoutSeconds":600,"extra":{"name":"USD Coin","version":"2"}}]}. The client signs an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization for that amount and retries the same request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header carrying the signed authorization.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64url-encoded x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED manifest JSON with accepts[].amount in micro-USDC. Example (decoded): {"x402Version":2,"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","asset":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","payTo":"0x795dCA28d0e8a0E5d19D689163f125a7da1D0B83","resource":"https://csv-parquet.YOURDOMAIN.workers.dev/v1/compress","description":"CSV-to-Parquet compression of 12345678 bytes"}

502.description: Upstream conversion worker failed (PyArrow/RunPod error during conversion)

504.description: Gateway timeout — stream did not complete within the allowed window
